court_name: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
government_department_involved: The Public Prosecutor, High Court of Telangana and A.P Hyderabad
raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the criminal appeal filed by the accused, confirming the conviction and sentence for offences under Sections 363, 302 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012. The court found that the prosecution proved the guilt of the appellant beyond reasonable doubt, establishing that the accused was last seen with the deceased, her death was homicidal, and she was subjected to rape.
